statement: Three isolated patches to FLINT 657a2839 reduce complete-operation time on an Apple M2 (one thread), measured as two resident libraries in interleaved ABBA/BAAB quartets after exact checks. (1) Integer squaring, patches/c3-register-reconstruction.patch: fusing two-prime reconstruction with carry propagation reduces complete squaring wall time by 2.99% [1.94, 4.11] and 2.91% [2.02, 3.74] (aggregate, 95% intervals) in two confirmation runs over sampled 4,096-16,384-limb operands. (2) Polynomial matrices, patches/poly-prepared.patch: preparing each reusable left spectral input once reduces complete-call CPU by 4.34-15.09% across all 30 eligible tested cases, with positive intervals in both confirmation runs. (3) Theta, patches/theta-direct-walsh.patch + theta-batch-retained.patch: median CPU reductions versus original FLINT of 3.65%, 4.92% and 5.84% at 1, 4 and 16 points per call (512 bits, genus 2-3); adding theta-equal-bank.patch, squared-constant totals fall by 4.38-9.13% by genus versus original FLINT. The theta figures describe different input conditions and are not additive.
status: Accepted on one machine; replication on other hardware is the open bottleneck.
scope: One Apple M2, macOS, Apple clang 21, -O3 -g -mcpu=apple-m2 -fno-omit-frame-pointer, GMP 6.3.0, MPFR 4.2.2, one FLINT thread, FLINT commit in deps.json. Sizes and fixtures are sampled: no minimum gain is claimed at every size, nor absence of regressions elsewhere in FLINT. Balanced multiplication (not squaring) under C3 is weaker: 1.43% [-0.02, 2.77]. The equal-bank theta result uses two fixtures and is not a representative workload distribution. Patches are experimental and not submitted upstream.

assumptions.statement: The gains are not specific to the M2 microarchitecture, compiler and memory system.
C3 builds and keeps a gain outside Apple Silicon. It uses FLINT's vector abstractions; an x86 AVX2 build has not been tried.
A genuine complete caller spends enough time in the patched routines at these sizes for the gains to matter.
The patched FLINT passes the test suite beyond the touched modules.

reproduce_full: On Apple Silicon macOS: make, then the Reproduce commands in docs/experiments-m2.md, docs/prepared-inputs-m2.md (Reproduction and artifacts) and docs/theta-equal.md (Reproduction), with new output directory names.
prerequisites: For reproduce_full: Apple Silicon macOS, Xcode command-line tools, Homebrew gmp, mpfr, autoconf, automake, libtool
